bug_info.bug_desc: In tlul_err_resp.sv, the response d_size was hardwired to '0 regardless of the accepted request's a_size. The old code only latched err_source and err_opcode when a request was accepted, but did not latch a_size. As a result, any response to a request with a nonzero size carried an incorrect d_size, violating the TL-UL requirement that d_size match a_size.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add a size state register, reset it, capture tl_h_i.a_size when the request handshake is accepted (a_valid && a_ready), and drive tl_h_o.d_size from that registered size. Use the actual width of tl_h_i.a_size for the register declaration, e.g. via $bits(tl_h_i.a_size), and similarly ensure err_source uses the width of tl_h_i.a_source.
